This page lists the standard document types of the [Knowledge Base](/reference/glossary/#knowledge-base), so you can see what each one captures and which template it comes from.

<!-- generated — do not edit; source: canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/*.md -->

`/aid-discover` populates these documents in the `.aid/knowledge/` folder of your project. `INDEX.md`, `README.md` and `STATE.md` sit beside them as generated or process files. Your project can change the set: see [Declared doc-set](/reference/glossary/#declared-doc-set). To learn how the Knowledge Base works, read [the Knowledge Base concept page](/concepts/knowledge-base/).

Each row names a document type, the title of its template, what it captures and the template it is written from.

| Doc type | Title | What it captures | Template |
|----------|-------|------------------|----------|
| `architecture` | Architecture | Architectural patterns, levels, data flow and module boundaries. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/architecture.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/architecture.md) |
| `coding-standards` | Coding Standards | Coding conventions mined from the actual code: naming, formatting, idioms and process rules. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/coding-standards.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/coding-standards.md) |
| `domain-glossary` | Domain Glossary | Project-specific vocabulary, with a definition for each domain and AID term. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/domain-glossary.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/domain-glossary.md) |
| `external-sources` | External Sources | A registry of the external documentation, vendor specs and reference URLs the project depends on. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/external-sources.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/external-sources.md) |
| `feature-inventory` | Feature Inventory | The feature list, with status and traceability to work items. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/feature-inventory.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/feature-inventory.md) |
| `infrastructure` | Infrastructure | Distribution model, environments, CI/CD setup, source-control conventions and project management tooling. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/infrastructure.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/infrastructure.md) |
| `integration-map` | Integration Map | What the project consumes and exposes, and how its components communicate. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/integration-map.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/integration-map.md) |
| `module-map` | Module Map | For each module: its purpose, dependencies, owners and key entry points. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/module-map.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/module-map.md) |
| `pipeline-contracts` | API Contracts | Public API surfaces, schemas, request and response shapes, and protocol contracts. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/pipeline-contracts.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/pipeline-contracts.md) |
| `project-structure` | Project Structure | Repository layout and the purpose of each top-level directory. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/project-structure.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/project-structure.md) |
| `schemas` | Data Model | Data schemas, artifact shapes, dataflow and cardinality relationships. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/schemas.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/schemas.md) |
| `tech-debt` | Tech Debt | Open technical debt items, tagged by severity, with a remediation path for each. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/tech-debt.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/tech-debt.md) |
| `technology-stack` | Technology Stack | Languages, runtimes, frameworks, build tools and test infrastructure. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/technology-stack.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/technology-stack.md) |
| `test-landscape` | Test Landscape | Test frameworks, coverage areas and gaps. | [`canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/test-landscape.md`](https://github.com/AndreVianna/aid-methodology/blob/master/canonical/aid/templates/knowledge-base/test-landscape.md) |
